scope.pipeline: prepared CUDA sensor poses to raw owned CUDA distance/identity/hit/triangle; includes GL draw, GL/CUDA interop, D2D copies and Torch output formatting
scope.postprocess: fixed raw CUDA images and prepared mounted poses to formal GPU observation; no rendering
scope.end_to_end: unmodified formal sample_depth/sample_camera/sample_rig API on CUDA input poses; rig includes mounts
scope.excluded: map load, source hashing, CPU pose generation/upload, UI HTTP/base64/image downloads, scene motion and renderer construction
scope.nonadditive: stages measured independently with synchronization; their medians need not sum to complete-call latency

input.algorithm: repeat: duplicate first case; varied: numpy.default_rng.uniform(-1,1,6) per view after first, translation offsets scaled by (.25,.25,.15)m and RPY offsets (8,6,12)deg; prefixes identical across batch sizes

geometry.batch_geometry_policy: one VBO; world meshes and local spheres; independent of B
geometry.input_pose: float32 CUDA B44; row-major camera FLU to world
geometry.output: owned CUDA distance float32 and identity int64 BHW
geometry.output_transfer: whole array to PBO in GL; one CUDA D2D PBO-to-Torch copy
geometry.interop_synchronization: CUDA GL-resource map/unmap on current PyTorch stream
geometry.near_clip_policy: unchanged GL w=forward, clip z=0, no positive near plane
geometry.zone_sampling: exact triangle/cell cone clip and nearest point; no supersampling

first_forward_gl_memory.tracked_total_scope: explicit GL storage; depth24 estimated as 4 bytes/texel; zone depth32 uses 4 bytes/texel; excludes driver padding/objects and all Torch allocations

pipeline.cuda_event_scope: whole CUDA stream span, including host submission/interop gaps; not pure kernel execution

gl_memory_after.tracked_total_scope: explicit GL storage; depth24 estimated as 4 bytes/texel; zone depth32 uses 4 bytes/texel; excludes driver padding/objects and all Torch allocations

production_parity.comparison: exact, including NaN/+inf classes, masks and IDs
